info.title: ApiToolKit - Google Workspace APIs
info.description: ASP.NET Core Clean Architecture integration for all Google Workspace APIs. Covers Auth (OAuth 2.0), Gmail (Messages, Labels, Drafts, Threads, Settings), Google Drive (Files, Permissions, Revisions, Shared Drives), Google Calendar (Calendars, Events, ACL, Free/Busy), Google Sheets (Spreadsheets, Values, Batch Operations), Google Docs (Documents, Content Editing), Google Slides (Presentations, Slides, Elements), Google Meet (Spaces, Recordings, Participants, Conference Records), Google Chat (Spaces, Messages, Members), and Google Forms (Forms, Items, Responses) modules.
